name_zh: 米塞夫/马其顿/名字/身份：名字争议与身份建构
description_zh: 克尔斯泰·米塞夫 (1874-1926) / 格奥尔基·马其顿/马其顿民族/身份/名字/争议/希腊/保加利亚/南斯拉夫/马其顿语/标准化/1944/马其顿/共和国/1991/独立/希腊/反对/马其顿/名称/2018/普雷斯帕/协议/北马其顿/北约/欧盟/身份/建构/遗产/马其顿/名字/争议。核心模式：名字争议身份建构 — 名字/身份/争议/协议/北马其顿/北约/欧盟/遗产/马其顿/米塞夫。体现 M250 名字争议/身份建构 — 以"名字+身份+争议+协议"四位一体，在希腊/保加利亚/南斯拉夫/国际四重争夺中构建马其顿名字争议身份建构范式。
description_en: Krste Misirkov (1874-1926) / Georgi/Macedonia/nation/identity/name/dispute/Greece/Bulgaria/Yugoslavia/Macedonian/language/standardization/1944/Macedonia/Republic/1991/independence/Greece/opposition/Macedonia/name/2018/Prespa/Agreement/North/Macedonia/NATO/EU/identity/construction/legacy/Macedonia/name/dispute. Core model: Name Dispute Identity Construction — name/identity/dispute/agreement/North Macedonia/NATO/EU/legacy/Macedonia/Misirkov. Exemplifies M250 Name Dispute/Identity Construction — quaternity of 'name + identity + dispute + agreement' building Macedonian name dispute identity construction paradigm amid quadruple contestation of Greece/Bulgaria/Yugoslavia/international.
reason_zh: 马其顿名字争议非单纯外交纠纷，而是"名字+身份+争议+协议"四位一体民族建构。从米塞夫奠基马其顿语标准化，到1944马其顿共和国建立，再到2018普雷斯帕协议更名北马其顿。M250 区隔于 M248 希腊独裁(梅塔克萨斯)、M249 阿尔巴尼亚隔离(霍查)、M251 波黑代顿(季蒂奇)，核心在于"名字即身份核心+争议即生存斗争+协议即国际认可"的马其顿名字争议身份建构范式。
reason_en: Macedonian name dispute not mere diplomatic row but 'name + identity + dispute + agreement' quaternity nation-building. From Misirkov founding Macedonian language standardization, to 1944 Macedonian Republic establishment, to 2018 Prespa Agreement renaming North Macedonia. M250 distinct from M248 Greek Dictatorship (Metaxas), M249 Albania Isolation (Hoxha), M251 Bosnia Dayton (Djindjic), core: 'name as identity core + dispute as survival struggle + agreement as international recognition' Macedonian name dispute identity construction paradigm.
